sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Sister language Tigemaxo (tiey1235), not Tiemacèwè. p.1 table lists 'Tiɛma Cɛwɛ - Lac Débo' with no further data; sec. 1.4.1 (p.8) identifies Monteil 1932 as mostly Jenaama/Sorogaama of Djenné and Daget et al. 1953 as a Jenaama/Sorogaama variety of Mopti. For Tigemaxo itself: sec. 3.1.3 p.22 'Tigemaxo tone patterns have few similarities to those of pitch accent languages'; p.39 'In the absence of a weight-sensitive word-level accentual system..'.

sources.citation: Hantgan, Abbie, Hiba Babiker & Johann-Mattis List. 2022. CLDF dataset 'Bangime and Friends 2' (lexibank/baf2), underlying 'First steps towards the detection of contact layers in Bangime: a multi-disciplinary, computer-assisted approach', Open Research Europe 2:10. Doculect BozoTiemaCewe (tiem1235, boo), 131 forms, source Smeltzer & Smeltzer 1995.
sources.note: Nothing: segmental forms only (e.g. koⁿoⁿbo 'animal', guro 'bark'); 12 of 131 Tiema Cewe forms carry acute/grave diacritics (e.g. jóŋŋà, dámìnɛ́ 'begin') with no statement of what they encode; no notes field on prosody. Secondary database reuse, not a description; cannot support a catalog statement.

sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress/accent. Image-only scan, scanned (tesseract fra, 300 dpi). Lexicostatistic revision of Smeltzer & Smeltzer; sec. 3.2.3 'Le niveau phonologique' treats vowel length/nasality instability, intervocalic consonant loss and inter-dialect consonant correspondences (Tiema Cewe /l/~/t/, /l/~/n/); p.34: Tiema Cewe shares 78.5% with Tieyaxo, 'le peu de données du tiema cewe sont moins fiables que la moyenne, une étude approfondie sera indispensable'.
